title: Document-level mutations (scenes, properties)
description: Add pure model helpers to packages/core for document-level operations: addScene, removeScene, renameScene, reorderScenes, duplicateScene (on FlashDocument). Also updateDocumentProperties (returns new FlashDocument with merged properties), updateGridSettings, addGuide, removeGuide, moveGuide. Export from packages/core/src/index.ts. No UI changes — pure model/core only. See docs/01-documents-stage-scenes.md.
